messages:
Anna (sec-eng): Heads up — PR #492 changed audit schema for permission checks. We're seeing ~2.5x event volume in staging and KMS costs spiked. Anyone else?

Mike (infra): saw it. RBAC change expanded 'read' checks to every resource access. That added per-request audit rows.

Jess (product): Oof. Which events are high-volume? can we drop some customer-visible fields?

Anna (sec-eng): Main culprits: permission_evaluated, policy_match (per-resource), and policy_trace. Example schema diff:

```json
- "event_type": "policy_evaluated",
- "resource": {"id": "r123", "type": "dataset"},
+ "event_type": "policy_evaluated",
+ "resource_id": "r123",
+ "policy": "dataset.read"
```

Leo (sre): Perf numbers: staging ingest rate went from 8k/s to 20k/s after the deploy. ES indexing latency doubled, and KMS decrypts (per-event envelope) up ~3x.

Anna (sec-eng): Proposed mitigations:
- add low-priority queue for policy_trace and sample at 1% by default
- batch KMS ops: envelope-level signatures for group-of-events
- dedup resource-level events for identical resource/action within 1s
- backpressure circuit: reject low-priority with 429 when queue depth>Q

Mike (infra): +1. Also suggest a temporary RBAC tweak: collapse per-resource checks server-side to aggregated check for common patterns. That avoids per-resource audit events.

Jess (product): Customer-facing validation: we should expose a knob for customers to opt into 'full_policy_trace' with clear cost docs and warnings. That avoids surprising bills. @legal needs to approve the wording.

Anna (sec-eng): Quick config snippet for batching/circuit-breaker:

```yaml
audit:
  queues:
    high: priority
    low: best_effort
  batching:
    max_batch: 500
    max_wait_ms: 50
  circuit_breaker:
    max_queue_length: 20000
    reject_ratio: 0.8
    cooldown_s: 30
```

Leo (sre): For indexing cost, consider using sparse mappings and only index fields used in customer queries (avoid indexing policy_trace details). Also switch to hourly rollups for high-cardinality attributes.

Mike (infra): KMS idea: instead of per-event envelope encryption, encrypt daily blobs per-tenant and store an HMAC per-event. That reduces KMS calls massively but changes replayability guarantees.

Anna (sec-eng): Noted. We need to document security tradeoffs. Add to vuln triage: Threat model for blob approach, plus mitigation (shorter key TTL, audit trail).

Jess (product): Action items:
- Anna: prototype sampling + dedup in staging (ETA: 2d)
- Mike: cost model for KMS alternatives (ETA: 3d)
- Leo: mapping/indexing plan + expected $ delta (ETA: 2d)
- Jess: customer opt-in UX copy + legal check (ETA: 3d)

Anna (sec-eng): tagging oncall and incident folks. If we hit >50k/s again, auto-enable sampling and notify customers via status page. @deploy-bot please add a short runbook snippet.

deploy-bot: Runbook entry created: "audit-ingest-high-volume" — contains steps: enable-sampling, flip-dedup, scale-ingesters, notify-status.

Leo (sre): I'll schedule a postmortem if staging numbers make it to prod.

Mike (infra): One more note: we should add unit of measure to billing expectations: per-indexed-document vs per-ingest-event so customers understand what's billable.

Anna (sec-eng): Thanks — will follow up with PR to add sampling flags and config. :thumbsup:
